text: The rag keeps going over the same six inches of counter.
notes: Placeholder. Reserved id range bus-pNNN; the content deck uses BUS-NNN.

text: A cigarette gets lit, set on the edge of the shelf, and left to go out.
The ledger stays open the whole while, a finger holding the place.
Two glasses go up on the shelf, then a third, slower.
A hat goes round in two hands, brim to brim.
One hand finds the door frame and stays on it.
Coffee gets poured for me without my asking, and then talked over.
A bottle goes back on the shelf label out, the way the house likes it.
The register book gets turned round so I can see it and turned back before I can.
